answer: Analogous to pedigree verification in livestock breeding, each agent must anchor its identity to a provable lineage record so a sybil cannot forge a false ancestry without breaking hash-linked parentage. Every verified registration emits a ripple through the kinship graph, letting peers cross-check shared ancestors and flag duplicated lineages before a fraudulent voyage. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
